name: medical_first_aid_notice
description: A note home after a pupil received first aid at school, sent to contacts with parental responsibility.
subject: First aid at school - {pupil_name}
body: We are letting you know that {pupil_name} received first aid at school on {incident_date} {incident_time}.
Please keep an eye on {pupil_name} and seek medical advice if you are worried, particularly after any bump to the head (drowsiness, sickness, headache or confusion).

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.sender_name: The member of staff sending it
